paragraphs: Audit and accounting professional with 2.5+ years of financial statement audit experience (statutory, internal and tax audit) and 4+ years in GAAP accounting, tax compliance and financial analysis across industries including FMCG, real estate, transportation, professional services and banking. Skilled in substantive testing, control testing, risk-based audit workpapers and data analytics using Excel, CaseWare IDEA and Alteryx.

Recent internal audit experience spanning IT, finance, accounting and HR functions, including risk and control matrix evaluation and remediation follow-up. Completing an MS in Audit & Advisory Services at DePaul University (GPA 3.52, expected Jan 2027); planning to pursue CPA licensure.
